unlisted_practices: Generating context-enhanced synthetic clinical notes from Reddit posts to train small language models for detecting low self-esteem
Mixed-method evaluation of synthetic notes (structure, readability, linguistic diversity, contextual fidelity)

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based synthetic clinical note generation framework from Reddit data to identify low self-esteem, evaluating synthetic text properties and NLP model performance without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
